title: The Changing-Lines Lens
kicker: The Recursive I Ching · one line, one direction, 32 hexagrams
description: The I Ching read one line and one direction at a time, starting with the fifth line, the ruler's place, turning from yang to yin: the tradition on the six places, the four trigrams that lose their middle, the 32 solid fifth lines and the 32 broken ones they become, and how often a cast lands there. Twelve tables in the appendix.
